subtitle: Over 55 years in the commercial door/hardware industry.
paragraphs: Founded in 1968, General Building Products has over 55 years in the commercial door/hardware industry. We offer a full line of commercial doors/frames, and all the associated hardware.
We have a complete hollow metal and door fabrication shop, where we can customize a solution for your unique situation.
Our staff includes a bonded locksmith as well as an AHC certified consultant.
